QuestInfo.name: Luke the Security Guy
QuestInfo.0: Let's meet #b#p226##k the Security Guy at the #m10001100#.
QuestInfo.1: At the Dungeon Entrance, I met #p226#, the guard. He told me that he wanted to make a nourishing snack for his mother and asked me to hunt #r20 #o18#s#k and #r20 #o17#s#k and bring back #b10 #t4000018#s#k, #b10 #t4000017#s#k, and #b1 #t2020000##k. He said he's too busy with his guard duties to do it himself... but, honestly, he looks like he's sleeping on the job!!
QuestInfo.2: I got #p226#, who protects the entrance of the dungeon, the stuff he asked for. Since he was already making the Snake Drink and all... I wanted a taste for myself! In return, #p226# gave me a nicely refined jewel he found around the area. It's not like refined jewels fall from the sky... Did someone lose it while traveling? Anyway, I should drop by later when the Snake Drink is ready...

0.0: Hmmm... Wait! You must be pretty strong, huh? I have a favor to ask you... As a good son, every year I make my mom a special, healthy, and tasty drink, but I don't have any free time these days because of my job guarding this spot. I'm sorry, but can you help me get the ingredients I need for the drink?

yes.0: All right! This year, I'm trying to make my mom a very tasty Snake Drink! Can you hunt some monsters and bring me #b10 #t4000018#s#k, #b10 #t4000017#s#k, and, for dessert, #b1 #t2020000##k please? Please find me once you've gathered everything up!

no.0: Must be busy here and there, huh? Please come back and do me this favor when you have some spare time.

1.0: Oh wow... You actually got everything!! This will definitely help me make a very tasty Snake Drink... It's a rare drink, so I usually wouldn't share it with anyone else, but I'll make an exception for you... When the drink is done, please drop by and have some with us. Promise?
1.1: Oh yeah... Since you worked hard to get me all the ingredients, I need to give you something in return. Now, what would be good... Oh yeah! Around here, you tend to see lots of shiny, sparkling objects. I've collected a lot of them, but as of this moment, this one is yours. It'll help you through your journey. Here, take it.

yes.0: Got it? Thanks for your help... Now I must rush back home! So long!

item.0: I'm trying to make my mom a very tasty Snake Drink! Can you get me #b10 #t4000018#s#k, #b10 #t4000017#s#k, and, for dessert, #b1 #t2020000##k please? Please find me once you have gathered them all up!

mob.0: Don't forget to defeat the monsters too!
